ideas.pitch: An autonomous multi-agent diagnostic platform for campus electrical and electronics hardware labs, using fast machine learning and LLMs to detect power grid anomalies and equipment failures in real time.
ideas.title: Smart Campus IoT Anomaly Detector
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targeting the Hardware & Software track with a direct focus on institutional campus operations makes the problem instantly relatable to ECE/EE departments and judges.

ideas.pitch: A training-free semantic router and retrieval engine designed specifically to parse complex VLSI chip datasheets and hardware documentation for instant query routing.
ideas.title: Semantic VLSI Datasheet Router
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly appeals to the VLSI Design & Technology department organizing the event by solving a tedious literature-search problem for hardware engineers.

ideas.pitch: An offline-first AI code review assistant tailored for embedded systems and microcontroller firmware, catching memory leaks and race conditions before deployment.
ideas.title: Autonomous Embedded Code Review Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines software intelligence with hardware-centric development workflows, fitting the exact interdisciplinary theme of the ECE/EE departments.

ideas.pitch: A pre-deployment risk diagnosis and compliance validator for university lab experiments, mapping safety protocols using BPMN workflows and automated agentic reasoning.
ideas.title: BPMN-Orchestrated Lab Safety Workflow Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates strict governance and process automation, appealing to judges looking for robust, production-ready safety implementation plans.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight inference optimization framework that helps resource-constrained edge hardware run complex reasoning models efficiently without sacrificing accuracy.
ideas.title: Inference-Optimized Edge Compute Benchmarker
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses hardware constraints directly, which will resonate heavily with the VLSI and ECE faculty members serving on the judging panel.
